verdict: The raid HUD is readable but cluttered: four overlapping notification and legend stacks, mismatched panel styles, and no single hero element.

findings.where: bottom centre, between the pad legend and the hotbar
findings.what: The pad legend (a 6-row, 4-column table in tiny dim type) sits right above 'pillager joined' and the 'scav pistol / fire / use' hint. It reads as a debug dump, and the three stacked layers crowd the hotbar. The legend is also an explaining table, which the brief counts as clutter.
findings.fix: Hide the legend during live play. Show it only on hold-view or in the first 10 seconds, as a single-row 16px hint strip. Keep the toast stack at least 24px clear of the hotbar top.

findings.where: left middle, bottom left, top centre
findings.what: Three separate toast systems with different looks: left rows with orange or white bars ('codex entry', 'contract item nearby', 'controller connected'), centre black pills ('controller connected', 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box'), and a 'pillager joined' pill. 'Controller connected' and 'contract item nearby' each appear twice. The gold-glow line is an explaining sentence.
findings.fix: Use one toast component, anchored in one place, and de-duplicate by id. Remove the centre pills for events already in the left stack. Delete 'gold glow marks the box'. Use one 4px radius, one --ui-panel fill, and a 3px left tab for the type.

findings.where: top-right career list, minimap, run info
findings.what: The money rows are four fat bars of different widths and heights ($900, xp, stash, backpack). The first has no label and is a blank black bar. The hero value is not obvious, and the column conflicts with the stacked panels beneath it. The minimap is flush to the screen edge, and 'run info' touches its bottom edge with no gap.
findings.fix: Use equal 40px rows with a label in tx-2 at 16px and a value in tx-1. Add a label to the first row, for example 'cash'. Put 16px gaps between the stack, the minimap and run info, and a 5% margin from the screen edge.

findings.where: run info panel, 'concealed · in cover' tag, 'extraction c available'
findings.what: The bottom-right strip uses three different treatments: a dark panel with bright white text, a lone amber-bordered pill with amber text, and a teal text line on a dark bar overlapping the panel edge. 'extraction c available' collides with the bottom of the run info card. 'no elite killed yet' in lime beside plain white contract lines is inconsistent.
findings.fix: Put all status tags in one right-aligned column of 8px-gap pills, with --warn for the warning glyph only. Add 8px between run info and the extraction line. Use tx-2 for objective lines, and lime only for the active one.

findings.what: 'hp 100' is large, but the label is clipped into the bar. The flat green and blue bars are unrelated to the dark panel language used elsewhere (no panel, no border), and 'standing' floats as a tab above them. They sit on a busy blue floor and the white text contrast is weak.
findings.fix: Put hp and stamina in one --ui-panel card with a 1px border, 8px padding and 4px radius. Use 16px labels left-aligned and the number at 32px. Keep a fixed 24px gap from the hotbar and the screen edge.

findings.what: The hero ammo '12 / 24' is in the right place and sized right. However 'view backpack' sits in the same line as the weapon area and has no key glyph, and '3 items $1,220' competes with it. The lime tick at the top is an orphan bar. The panel has a different fill and edge from the neighbouring HUD cards.
findings.fix: Move 'view backpack' to a 16px key-hint chip with its pad or key glyph below the panel. Drop the orphan tick or make it a full 2px top tab 36px wide. Use the shared panel tokens.

findings.where: top left: 'current pillager bots 3' panel and 'pillager' name bar
findings.what: The panel has tiny, tight rows, mixed lime and white text, and a chevron that is barely visible. The 'pillager' health bar below it has a different border and fill again. The right-aligned $ values are fine, but the type is smaller than the 16px floor.
findings.fix: Set 16px row type with 24px row height and 8px padding. Use one header style for all collapsible panels (run info, bots, legend) with the same chevron. Restyle the pillager bar as part of the same panel family.

findings.what: The hotbar is the cleanest part. The selected slot has an amber ring and the other active slot a blue one, so two highlights compete. The slot digits are tiny and the empty slots are silhouettes that clutter the row. The rb chip is the only key glyph.
findings.fix: Use one lime focus ring for the selected slot and mark the equipped slot with a quiet lime top tick only. Raise the digits to 16px. Dim the empty silhouettes to 25% or hide them.
